recommendations.title: Fix the stale hermes-gateway systemd unit before the next restart
recommendations.reason: This has been outstanding since the June 27 dreaming sequence — two full days. Every gateway restart logs a WARNING about TimeoutStopSec=90s vs drain_timeout=180s. With the gateway restarting multiple times per day, systemd can SIGKILL it mid-drain when the 90s stop timeout fires against a 180s drain. This is a compounding data-loss and stability risk.
recommendations.action: From a shell (not inside the gateway process): `hermes gateway service install --replace && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart hermes-gateway`. Then verify with `journalctl -u hermes-gateway -n 30 | grep -i stale` — should return nothing.

non_negotiable.title: Fix the stale hermes-gateway systemd unit now
non_negotiable.reason: This is now day 2 of this item sitting outstanding. The gateway is known to restart multiple times per day. Each restart with the current stale unit config risks an unclean shutdown where systemd SIGKILLs the process at 90s while the drain is still running (180s timeout). The longer it sits, the higher the chance of a restart happening and data loss compounding. The fix is a single command that takes under 60 seconds.
non_negotiable.action: Run: `hermes gateway service install --replace && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart hermes-gateway`. Verify: `journalctl -u hermes-gateway -n 20` should show no stale-unit warning.
